items.answer: To use 'X' to the exponent in the calculator, switch to the scientific calculator mode [3] and then use the 'X^y' button to enter the exponent [3].

items.q: In calculator, how do I use Absolute value?
items.answer: To use the Absolute value in the calculator, you can select the **Scientific** mode [8], and then input the number you want to find the absolute value of, and press the **Abs** button [4].
